filesystem: ext4 on /dev/nvme0n1p7; same /tmp device for every engine
profile: cargo release; default opt-level3; debug_assertions=false; no CPU, IO, or cache isolation

durability.home: one append-only frame and sync_all per transaction
durability.surrealkv-native: transaction Immediate; set_at and soft tombstones at Graph revision; native get_at and history iterator; unlimited retention; shared Graph history also retained
durability.neon-layers: native DeltaLayerWriter finish sync_all; atomic committed-layer rename and directory sync; catalog publication after both syncs

neon_io: Native StdFs with buffered filesystem I/O and sync enabled. Native auto detection reports tokio-epoll-uring creation fails with EPERM on this host. Default configured page cache and descriptor count; one owner runtime, native page cache global.
neon_layout: One actual delta layer per transaction, including initial revision1. Stable numeric IDs map variable original keys to native 18-byte keys. New mappings and changed payloads share the same layer. RAM stores key-to-ID catalog only; decoded Arrow property cache is shared native Graph behavior.
neon_limits: No production Safekeeper WAL/quorum, remote storage, background compaction, or native timeline branching. Forced per-transaction durable layer flush differs from production WAL-backed batching.
history: At each original captured Graph cut, replay actual Causal index/detect with original inputs after writes and after reopen, backward then forward. Exact staged Arrow commands, clear sequences, call key vectors, frontier and unchanged head/rollback are asserted at runtime. Exact key bytes and Arrow values are not serialized to this timing report.
history_after_reopen: Property hydration and eight existing finite historical inspect checks precede these package replays. This is restart/history proof and warm read timing, not a cold-cache test.

unit_result: All eight focused release tests pass at the measured Rust source. No relevant Rust edit follows that test run.
normal_root_qualification: Seven focused root example tests pass before the final removal of an unused Surreal write forwarding method. The final isolated eight-test run covers those same test bodies and the changed write_at calls.
pre_run_compilers: Host process check immediately before measurement returns zero cargo, rustc, or cc1plus processes; retained in pre-run-processes.json.

build_compatibility: Neon PostgreSQL14–17 header-only setup; no PostgreSQL server is built or run.
SchedulingResult visibility matches its existing crate-visible trait for the current compiler.
Isolated mappings dependency pinned to 0.7.0, as in Neon upstream lock; 0.7.2 gives incompatible profiling Mapping types.
Isolated ABI generator required platform metadata dependency downloads. No ABI validation is disabled.
qualification: All measured engines pass original Graph/member/finding checks, six-evidence/four-stream/two-node assertions, metadata, retained history, rollback, explicit close/reopen and exact historical package replay assertions.
limits: Small actual package fixture with resolved inputs; no native DataFusion source queries, Control intake, Data authority, or notifications.
No production Neon performance claim; the measured Neon layer adapter has per-transaction layer flush and synchronous KV-to-async read bridging.
Native Surreal history is additional to shared explicit Graph revision keys; no specialized native-only Graph layout is measured.
No power-loss, steady compaction, large Graph, branch creation, retention deletion, or memory-pressure qualification.
Full workspace CI does not run, as the user requests.
